# Pull request / 変更提案

## Problem / 問題

Describe one concrete task and the limitation addressed. Use synthetic examples only.

## Resulting behavior / 変更後の振る舞い

Explain what changes and why. Identify changes to data handling, confirmation, and failure behavior.

## Validation / 検証

State the checks actually run and their results. Distinguish documentation checks, application tests, CI, and real user validation.

## Limitations / 制約

State material unverified behavior, compatibility limits, and any remaining decision.

## Checklist

- [ ] No real logs, secrets, private identifiers, rules, or alias maps are included.
- [ ] The change stays within the agreed milestone and scope.
- [ ] Both READMEs reflect changes to behavior, status, or limitations.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; unmet checks are explained without weakened expectations.
- [ ] Publication, settings, destructive operations, and distribution stay within explicit authorization.
